whyItMatters: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant.
actions: Record the licence class the project actually ships under, or stop depending on the component until it is known. Specifically: fix a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm package.json no longer carries a package.json whose `license` field defers to an unreadable or absent grant.
